title: Another Chance — First Morning [Questism Test]
opening:
[Questism | Breakfast, Again]
Objective: Go downstairs and join your family for breakfast. (0/1)

Morning — Your old bedroom

Your old bedroom surrounds you: the familiar desk, the schoolbag beside it, the view beyond the window. Your phone displays a date exactly ten years before the one on which you went to sleep.

Downstairs, plates clink and your family talks over breakfast.

"Breakfast is ready!" someone calls up the stairs.

The closed bedroom door separates the room from the hallway and the stairs. Downstairs, the household continues its morning routine.
